events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Oct 17
events.summary: New Added new Targeting grid to compact information and allow for easier mouse control. Picking a single-target move now opens a 3x3 targeting grid. Each enemy shows a head icon tinted green, yellow or red by health, plus its damage. The grid is on by default. To aim on the board instead: Settings > GAMEPLAY > TARGETING > BOARD. The encounter's name and icon now show at the top of the board. +1 AP: a new upgrade for the pistol, sawed-off and knife. Adds +1 AP to each roll. Its challenge is 50 ki

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Oct 15
events.summary: Changes Inventory now opens with TAB You can now open inventory at the fort, and at events Cursor memory added to combat menus BOTH BARRELS is now called 2 BARRELS. Balance Pot Shot: hit chance 50% > 48%, cost 2 AP > 1 AP Fixes PUT BACK on the loot screen could move items into the camp stash mid-run. It now only works at base and before a run.

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Oct 12
events.summary: New New boot splash recommends a controller Demo notice, Saves Don't Carry Over Settings has been split into GENERAL and ACCESSIBILITY tabs. New accessibility option: COMBAT DICE ANIMATION. Set it to OFF and your dice land on the weapon row straight away, with no roll animation. Fixes Enemy hitboxes have been adjusted for mouse clicking accuracy Combat pause: RETURN now puts the cursor back on the fight. events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Oct 10
events.summary: Changes Combat: each weapon in the menu now pulses while its AP can still buy a move. BACK pulses while the other weapon's AP can. Forts: the detail card's LEVEL panel is replaced by FAIL, which reads NONE. A missed roll only locks that choice for the visit; nothing else is lost. Balance Fort roll DCs 13 / 17 > 9 / 13 Fixes The AP number (weapon chip and HUD) now greys out once nothing paid is affordable. Free moves no longer keep it yellow.

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Oct 8
events.summary: Changes The tent mission was removed. New games start with 7 raw meat in the stash. Pot Shot is now a pinned starting mission next to the story. Volume sliders: today's mix now sits at 75%, so you can turn things up past it, and a limiter on Master keeps it clean. Your existing settings are converted once, so nothing sounds different after updating. Balance Rest Upgrade 2 now also costs 1 rock.

events.title: Art Breakdown: We Made Medium Rare With Stock Photos
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46264323/7227ba438860eefbf17733715eb68ec274b6d9d4.png Ever wondered where the look of Medium Rare comes from? Our artist put together a short video breaking down the process. How it's made It starts with stock photos. Each one gets a heavy paintover to pull it into the world of post-apocalyptic Oregon. Then come pixel-art fixes and animation, which bring the camp, the woods and the infected to life. If you like the look, we'd love a wishlist. Or a review! Wishlist Medium Rare

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Oct 7
events.summary: Balance Meat Courier HP 30 > 28 Butcher HP 20 > 25 Changes The tutorial setting is now saved per save file. Older saves turn it on only if a lesson had already been taught. The map's pause menu now has a MAIN MENU option, with a warning that the current run will be lost. Move tree: long cost lines now wrap, and moves with several requirements list them on separate lines. Updated a line in the intro: "It came for the crops and the animals."
